arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /bin/bash -lc '
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.rea-fix-status-20261030/scripts
src=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.rea-fix-status-20261030
live=/opt/telegram-robot-leads
test -d "$src/tests"
echo SOURCE_SHA=$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)
echo SOURCE_BRANCH=$(git -C "$src" branch --show-current)
echo SOURCE_TEST_GUARDS
grep -nF "self.assertIn(\x27--no-pm2\x27, current)" "$src/tests/test_safe_growth.py" || :
grep -nF "self.assertNotIn(\x27--with-pm2\x27, current)" "$src/tests/test_safe_growth.py" || :
echo LIVE_TEST_GUARDS
grep -nF -- "--no-pm2" "$live/tests/test_safe_growth.py" | tail -n 4
echo TEST_FILES_COMPARE
python3 - "$src" "$live" <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
src,live=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
for sub in ("tests","scripts"):
 d=0; equal=0; diff=[]
 for q in (src/sub).rglob("*"):
  if q.is_file() and not q.name.endswith(".pyc") and not q.name.startswith("."):
   r=live/q.relative_to(src)
   if not r.exists():diff.append("MISSING:"+str(q.relative_to(src)));continue
   if hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256(r.read_bytes()).digest():equal+=1
   else:diff.append(str(q.relative_to(src)))
 print("COMPARE",sub,"EQUAL",equal,"DIFFERENT",len(diff),"SAMPLE",",".join(diff[:25]))
PY
cd "$src"
/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -q
echo SOURCE_TESTS_PASS
git --no-pager diff --check
echo SOURCE_WORKTREE_STATUS
git --no-pager status --short
echo VERIFY_MAIN_DONE
'
